external_reference.object: Singer / perfect difference set representatives mod 57

interpretation: The n=57 exact interval Sidon embeddings sit on the Singer modulus 57 and cover all nonzero residues mod 57 with controlled redundancy, but they do not literally contain an affine image of the cited size-8 Singer PDS representatives.
claim_boundary: Finite certificate only: no asymptotic claim, no theorem proof, and no claim that the size-10 interval embeddings are Singer PDS objects.
